theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_translate_identities
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U U' : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U') (ζ : Amb n ℓ), V'.weight = V.weight.map (fun x => x - ζ) → (∀ x, V'.mult x = V.mult (ζ + x)) → (∀ x, V'.tangentProj x = V.tangentProj (ζ + x)) → (∀ s : ℝ, V'.weight (closedBall 0 s) = V.weight (closedBall ζ s)) ∧ (∀ (s : ℝ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), V'.tiltExcess 0 s T = V.tiltExcess ζ s T) ∧ (∀ (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p s : ℝ), V'.scaledLpNorm (fun x => H (ζ + x)) p 0 s = V.scaledLpNorm H p ζ s) ∧ ((∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂V'.weight, 1 ≤ V'.mult x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
